I have reviewed the normal colonoscopy results and the lack of blood or weight loss in your history; while this typically points toward Irritable Bowel Syndrome with diarrhea (IBS-D), the specific symptom cluster of urgent bowel movements, cramping relieved by defecation, and mucus discharge is highly characteristic of early or mild inflammatory bowel disease.
